profile.headline: Senior Web Developer
profile.summary:
Ever since I was thirteen, I dreamed of becoming an anesthesiologist living in a beach house in Australia. This ambition led me to intern at a local children’s hospital, take biochemistry and biotechnology classes in high school, and even obtain my CNA license at seventeen. However, my career path changed when I took my first computer science class and discovered the transformative power of software in advancing society. Since then, I've been passionate about becoming a developer.

I switched my major to computer science and embarked on a challenging yet rewarding journey. Although I initially struggled with the complex material and unfamiliar jargon, my curiosity and persistence paid off, and I graduated summa cum laude.

After graduation, I immersed myself in web development, learning HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Git/GitHub, Sass, ReactJS, MongoDB, and responsive design principles. Currently, I am a CMS developer, having worked on over 50 client CMS projects. I also use Anki to create flashcards and continuously learn new technologies.

My ultimate goal is to become a senior full-stack developer. With dedication, professional experience, and continuous learning, I am committed to honing my skills and advancing in my career.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: A continuation of my role as CMS Developer following the acquisition of Simpleview by Granicus. My responsibilities remained the same during this transition.

positions.title: CMS Developer
positions.description:
* Transitioned from supporting major clients like Visit Norway to playing a key role in the development of the CMS application for ASM Global.
* Created REPL scripts to streamline the identification of image usage across components (widgets, panels, navigation, blog posts) and to facilitate seamless data migration between sites post-renaming.
* Utilized a diverse tech stack, including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Vue, MongoDB, and Goatee templating, to deliver scalable, high-quality solutions.

positions.title: Frontend Team Lead
positions.description:
* Conducted second-round technical interviews.
* Met with the CTO weekly to discuss team dynamics and goals.
* Updated and created new materials for the frontend department, including the new frontend intern onboarding slides.

positions.title: Web Developer, Frontend Intern
positions.description:
* Refactored the frontend codebase to enhance maintainability, improve security practices, and reduce technical debt.
* Applied responsive web design techniques, optimizing user experiences and ensuring seamless functionality across a wide range of devices, including desktops, laptops, tablets, and mobile phones.
* Gained experience working with front-end libraries like styled components and AWS services such as API Gateway, Cognito, Amplify, and Lambda.
* Participated in a Scrum team, learning the importance of transparency, agile practices, and the iterative process, which boosted our team's productivity and progress.

positions.title: Learning Assistant
positions.description:
Computer Science 1 Learning Assistant:
* Provided one-on-one support during office hours, helping students grasp key concepts in computer science.
* Assisted in classroom sessions, offering support during lectures and breakout discussions to enhance learning.
* Collaborated with the professor weekly to discuss student engagement, share feedback, and contribute to the design of projects and activities.
positions.insights: Skills: Homework Help · Tutoring · Classroom Assistance · Office Hours

positions.title: Computer Administration Intern
positions.description:
* Resolved IT issues promptly, ensuring uninterrupted operations and minimizing downtime.
* Managed network tools such as VPNs and network-attached storage (NAS) systems, enhancing overall workplace productivity.
* Led the migration of the office PostgreSQL database to a Docker container, improving scalability and streamlining deployment processes.
positions.insights: Skills: Virtual Private Network (VPN) · Technical Support · Network-Attached Storage (NAS)

positions.title: Student Internship
positions.description:
* Assisted and shadowed medical assistants, residents, and doctors in day-to-day hospital operations.
* Earned commendations from staff for demonstrating enthusiasm and a strong willingness to learn about the medical field.
